# Fikrah HR

> Fikrah HR is a UAE-based human resources consultancy supporting businesses with practical, flexible HR advice, operational support, policies and procedures, HR audits, management training and HR systems projects. Founded by Sarah Brooks, Fikrah HR helps organisations manage employee lifecycle activities, strengthen HR practices and address people-related business challenges.

Fikrah HR works with organisations needing ongoing or short-term HR support, defined projects or specialist input. Its corporate services cover HR audits, policy development, recruitment and onboarding processes, employee relations and management support, HR information systems (HRIS), and preparation for operating in the UAE. Its website also describes UAE employment regulations training and experience on projects involving other GCC jurisdictions. Specific legal or regulatory requirements should be checked against the relevant jurisdiction and current official guidance.

## Core HR Services

- [Corporate HR Solutions](https://fikrahhr.com/corporate-hr-solutions): Overview of HR audits, policies and procedures, flexible outsourced HR support, management skills training, UAE employment regulations training, HR software implementation and HR considerations when expanding into the UAE.
